title: AI/ML Support Engineer
objective: AI/ML Support Engineer with half a decade of experience developing, deploying, troubleshooting, and supporting production machine learning and Generative AI systems on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Gemini, Dialogflow), AWS, and Azure. Strong foundation in compute fundamentals (Linux, virtualization, Docker/Kubernetes), deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX), and LLM/RAG architectures, with a proven record of diagnosing and resolving complex model, data pipeline, and infrastructure issues, optimizing model performance, and serving as the technical escalation point for AI/ML platform users across travel, healthcare, finance, and e-commerce domains.

profile.label: Troubleshooting & Diagnosis
profile.text: Half a decade of troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving complex issues across the AI/ML stack — data pipeline failures, training and inference errors, CUDA/OOM faults, model drift, latency regressions, and LLM hallucination/grounding defects — using structured root-cause analysis, log and trace correlation, and reproducible test cases.

profile.label: Support Methodology
profile.text: Serve as technical SME and escalation point for internal and customer-facing AI systems; manage issues through the full case lifecycle (triage, reproduce, diagnose, fix or workaround, validate, close) with clear RCAs, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles that prevent recurrence and reduce repeat tickets.

profile.label: Code Reading & Debugging
profile.text: Read, trace, and debug code in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Shell, SQL, and C++ across ML training scripts, inference services, API layers, and CI/CD pipelines; review system designs to identify reliability and scalability gaps.

profile.label: Compute Fundamentals
profile.text: Deep understanding of virtualization, containerization, and operating systems — Linux/Windows system administration, Docker image builds and hardening, Kubernetes cluster setup, upgrades, and troubleshooting (GKE, AKS, and bare metal), networking (CNI), storage (CSI), ingress, and GPU/resource scheduling.

profile.label: Google Cloud AI/ML
profile.text: Hands-on with Vertex AI (custom training, managed endpoints for online/batch prediction, Vertex AI Pipelines, Model Registry, evaluation), Gemini models via the Gemini API and Vertex AI, Dialogflow CX conversational agents, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, IAM, and Cloud Logging/Monitoring for model observability.

profile.label: Multi-Cloud Platforms
profile.text: Proficient on AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, EC2, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, Step Functions) and Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search, AKS, Key Vault, Application Insights); builds and supports infrastructure for training, serving, and monitoring AI models.

profile.label: Generative AI & LLMs
profile.text: Designs, deploys, and supports LLM applications — RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), evaluation (groundedness, relevance, coherence), and guardrails — using Gemini, GPT-4o, Claude, LLaMA, and open-source models from Hugging Face.

profile.label: ML Development & Deployment
profile.text: Develops and deploys models across supervised learning, time-series forecasting, NLP, computer vision, and deep learning (CNN, RNN/LSTM, Transformers) with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, JAX, and scikit-learn; serves them via Vertex AI endpoints, ONNX Runtime, TorchServe, TensorFlow Serving, and FastAPI microservices.

profile.label: Model Architectures & Accelerators
profile.text: Strong command of encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder transformer architectures (BERT, T5, GPT, LLaMA), diffusion models, GANs, VAEs, and autoencoders; trains and optimizes on NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA, mixed precision, quantization) and TPUs, scaling workloads with Ray and distributed training.

profile.label: Machine Learning APIs
profile.text: Integrates and troubleshoots ML APIs — Gemini/Vertex AI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face Inference — resolving authentication, quota and rate-limit errors, timeouts, streaming issues, and version/deprecation migrations (e.g., PaLM to Gemini).

profile.label: Data Pipelines & Analysis
profile.text: Builds and debugs data pipelines with Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, Dask, SQL, Airflow, and Prefect; performs data-quality analysis, feature engineering, and error-pattern analytics to isolate the root cause of model degradation.

profile.label: MLOps & Observability
profile.text: Implements CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and IaC (Bicep), experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases, TensorBoard), and production monitoring and drift detection with OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Application Insights, and Cloud Monitoring; automates retraining and rollback.

profile.label: Semantic Search & Vector Databases
profile.text: Designs and tunes retrieval systems with FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Qdrant, and Azure AI Search (vector + BM25 hybrid with reranking) to support RAG pipelines at scale.

profile.label: Collaboration & Communication
profile.text: Writes clear customer-facing RCAs and internal postmortems, mentors junior engineers, and partners with product, engineering, and customer teams to turn recurring issues into durable platform improvements.

Deployed and operated ML models on Vertex AI — custom training jobs, managed endpoints, and Vertex AI Pipelines with Model Registry versioning and automated evaluation; debugged training failures, endpoint deployment errors, IAM/quota issues, and latency and throughput regressions using Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring.

Built AI/ML-enabled software with Python (FastAPI/Flask microservices, asynchronous programming, REST/gRPC APIs) and TypeScript (React, Angular); integrated LLM applications with Pinecone, PostgreSQL, and Redis; read and debugged code across the stack to resolve integration defects.

Built agentic AI solutions with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), and MCP servers for tool-using assistants and system integrations; orchestrated workflows via Copilot Studio and n8n; power user of AI IDEs (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code).

Engineered end-to-end ML pipelines across regression, time-series forecasting, and deep learning (CNN, RNN, LSTM) with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and Spark/PySpark; orchestrated MLOps on Databricks with MLflow, Docker, and FastAPI; mentored junior engineers and guided cross-functional teams on AI governance, scalability, and enterprise adoption.

Operationalized deployment across Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure with Docker/Kubernetes and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins); embedded SAST/DAST security gates, code reviews, automated testing, and documentation into an Agile/Scrum delivery cadence.
